title: Injured in knife attack, 3-year-old boy dies
subtitle: A 3-year-old boy who was stabbed at an Oshawa birthday party Saturday died in hospital today.
article: A 3-year-old boy who was stabbed at an Oshawa birthday party Saturday died in hospital today.
Nathan Kelly was critically wounded in the stabbing and died at the Hospital for Sick Children this morning, Durham police said.
His family has decided to donate his organs to help other children. The family says his mother, Leslie Kelly, who was also stabbed to death during the attack, would have wanted it that way.
On Saturday afternoon, an attacker, identified as Gino Petralia, 47, of Oshawa, entered a Glen St. townhouse in south Oshawa armed with a knife and attacked the family that lived there.
Leslie Kelly, 26, was killed as she dove in front of the knife to save her husband's life. Rick Kelly, 29, and two of their three children were taken to hospital with stab wounds.
Rick Kelly and his son Riley are recovering in hospital and are expected to survive, police said.
Petralia was shot to death by Durham police after the brazen attack.
